results.title: One Guy, Too Many Dates
results.overview: After one too many disastrous dates, a talented software engineer creates a women-centered app where users can anonymously review their dating experiences. What begins as a simple idea quickly turns into a viral phenomenon, igniting chaos between men and women online, attracting media attention, and complicating Emily’s own love life. In a world where everyone has opinions about dating, Emily discovers that building an app about relationships might be easier than surviving one.

results.title: The Murder of Benjamin
results.overview: On a cold night in Holmlia, 15-year-old Benjamin is murdered by 19-year-old Joe Erling Jahr in a racially motivated assault. A year later, Benjamin's mother, Marit, faces her son’s killer in court.

results.title: Katseye: Lollapalooza Argentina 2026
results.overview: The multinational female K-pop group Katseye impressed and captivated the crowd with their hit song Gabriela.

results.title: Imitators
results.overview: A normal working day in a testing centre of the local government, which functions as a place to distinguish people from dangerous doppelgangers that appeared after the nuclear disaster in Chornobyl.

results.title: The India Story
results.overview: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

results.title: The Captain and the Caspian Sea
results.overview: The film tells the story of the national tragedy that occurred on January 20, 1990, the heroism of the captains of the Caspian Sea Oil Fleet, as well as the journalists and cameramen who filmed the events.

results.title: Rescue
results.overview: As the full-scale war in Ukraine forces millions to flee, rescuers move in the opposite direction - toward destroyed villages, active shelling, and mined roads - to save animals left behind when humans are forced to escape.

results.title: Blue Lagoon
results.overview: Blue Lagoon explores the links between industrial extraction, ecological care, and somatic release through the lens of a post-industrial North East England coastline.

results.title: Wild Blackberries
results.overview: An philosophical insight into living in London, United Kingdom in 2026. A personal love letter to loneliness and the hope of love to illustrate the ongoing divide within London.

results.title: The Exhibitor
results.overview: As a series of mysterious murders plague nearby hotels and expos, growing suspicion surrounds a woman whose dark past and erratic behavior threaten to expose her dangerous secrets.

results.title: The Hadron Collider: In Search of the Peace Particle
results.original_title: The Hadron Collider: In Search of the Peace Particle
results.overview: In the aftermath of Hiroshima, a group of scientists vowed never to turn knowledge into weapons again, and from that promise, CERN was born.  Deep underground, researchers from nations in conflict have worked side by side for decades, driven by curiosity and shared wonder. For 70 years, CERN has stood as an act of hope, a place where collaboration transcends borders, even as the world above grows more divided.  Blending poetry, music and rare archival footage of Oppenheimer with remarkable access to the Large Hadron Collider, the film explores how science, politics and culture collide.

results.title: La Petite Graine
results.overview: Denis and Céline dream of having a child. After years of unsuccessful artificial insemination, they decide to try one last resort: asking Piche, a former classmate who used to pick on Denis, to help them.

results.title: Laser-Cat
results.overview: When a laser pointer prank goes wrong, an anxious teenager crosses São Paulo in a single night to save his crush’s severely injured cat, as guilt and paranoia drive him toward collapse.

results.title: The Heritage
results.overview: Árpi (known to his sons simply as “Boss”) has been living alone for years after losing his wife, with whom he spent more than fifty years. In recent months, Árpi has spent practically all of his savings. His two sons, Attila and Kristóf, only realize this when the old man’s electricity is cut off due to his accumulated debt. This is more than strange for the elderly man, who lives a modest life, but he refuses to say a word about where the one and a half million forints went. Attila and Kristóf work together to coax the truth out of him: he gave the money to Hajnalka, a young woman with a difficult past. But who is this Hajnalka, whom they’ve never heard of before? The old man claims he’s in love. The boys claim the old man is being taken advantage of. Everyone clings to their own version of the truth. But the truth must be uncovered. The longest night of their lives begins. And even Hajnalka appears at the front door.

results.title: A Richer Christmas
results.overview: When a wealthy family loses everything before the holidays, their world falls apart — but in the chaos, they discover the true meaning of Christmas.

results.title: One Move at a Time
results.overview: In an alternative 1968, two women, one Black and one white, realize something about themselves during a game of chess.
